title: 2020 HMMT November Guts Problem 2
statement: Let \(a\) be a positive integer such that \(2 a\) has units digit 4. What is the sum of the possible units digits of \(3 a\) ?

solutions.text: If \(2 a\) has last digit 4 , then the last digit of \(a\) is either 2 or 7 . In the former case, \(3 a\) has last digit 6 , and in the latter case, \(3 a\) has last digit 1 . This gives a final answer of \(6+1=7\).
